svg.title: Libris — Librarian accounts
svg.desc: Create, edit and remove staff accounts. New accounts must change the temporary password.

g.text: Create, edit and remove librarian accounts. Superlibrarian accounts are managed separately.
New librarians receive a temporary password
They must choose a new password at first sign-in. Deleting an account keeps its past checkout records as “Former
Name and email are all that is required.
The librarian signs in and chooses a new
Books, loans, requests, students and fines.
